driver-layers.title: Three layers, one of them yours
driver-layers.alt: Layer diagram: the application calls VortexHostSession, which encodes NMT and expedited SDO frames and passes them to the VortexCanTransport interface, which your transport implements with BaseCan, SocketCAN or a loopback, which sends them on the CAN bus to the Vortex device.
driver-layers.description: From top to bottom. Your application calls a VortexHostSession (its public methods are listed from inc/vortex/VortexHostSession.hpp). The session encodes CANopen NMT and expedited SDO download frames as VortexCanFrame values and hands each to the VortexCanTransport interface (its pure-virtual methods are listed from inc/vortex/VortexCanTransport.hpp). Your transport class implements that interface with BaseCan, SocketCAN or a test loopback, and puts the frame on a classic CAN bus. The Vortex device on the bus is the CANopen server.
